---
title: "Model checks and sensitivity analyses (Supporting Information)"
author: "Elijah Magistrado"
output: html_document
---

Checks of the genus-centered models (Eq. 4) fitted in `climate analyses.Rmd`:
convergence and singularity, residual diagnostics, influence of single genera, tests and
confidence intervals for the random effects, sensitivity to the two largest genera, and
complete model tables. Tables are written to `tables/` and figures to `figures/`.

All models are fitted with glmmTMB by maximum likelihood (glmmTMB does not use REML by
default), to the same 480 taxa, with a Gaussian error distribution on natural-log traits.
Genus names are unique within families, so `(1 | family) + (... | genus)` is a nested
structure.

## Packages and data
```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(performance)
library(DHARMa)

figure_dir <- "figures"
table_dir <- "tables"
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Written by climate analyses.Rmd
xylem_stats <- read.csv("data/xylem_stats.csv", header = T)

# Log-transform a trait and MAP, and split log MAP into the genus mean
# (across-genus term) and the deviation from it (within-genus term), as in climate analyses.Rmd
center_by_genus <- function(data, trait, log_name) {
  data |>
    group_by(genus) |>
    mutate(
      "{log_name}" := log(.data[[trait]]),
      log_MAP = log(MAP),
      genus_mean_MAP = mean(log(MAP))
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(diff_from_genus_MAP = log_MAP - genus_mean_MAP)
}

traits <- list(
  Dh = center_by_genus(xylem_stats, "mean_Dh", "log_y"),
  VLF = center_by_genus(xylem_stats, "mean_VLF", "log_y")
)

# Genera are nested in families (each genus belongs to one family)
stopifnot(all(tapply(xylem_stats$family, xylem_stats$genus, n_distinct) == 1))
```

## Models
```{r}
# Eq. 4, the reduced models for likelihood-ratio tests of the random effects, and the pooled model (Eq. 5)
fit_models <- function(data) {
  list(
    full           = glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus), data = data),
    no_genus_slope = glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family) + (1 | genus), data = data),
    no_genus       = glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family), data = data),
    no_family      = glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus), data = data),
    pooled         = glmmTMB(log_y ~ log_MAP, data = data)
  )
}
models <- map(traits, fit_models)
```

## Convergence and singularity
```{r}
convergence <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) tibble(
  trait = trait,
  optimiser_code = m$full$fit$convergence,
  optimiser_message = m$full$fit$message,
  hessian_positive_definite = m$full$sdr$pdHess,
  singular_fit = check_singularity(m$full)
))
write.csv(convergence, file.path(table_dir, "model_convergence.csv"), row.names = F)
convergence
```

## Residual diagnostics
```{r}
# Simulation-based residuals (DHARMa). For glmmTMB the simulations re-draw the random
# effects, so the tests check the whole model, not only the residual term.
residual_tests <- imap_dfr(models, function(m, trait) {
  res <- simulateResiduals(m$full, n = 1000, seed = 1)
  png(file.path(figure_dir, paste0("figS_residuals_", trait, ".png")), width = 2000, height = 1000, res = 200)
  plot(res)
  dev.off()
  tibble(
    trait = trait,
    uniformity_KS_p = testUniformity(res, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
    dispersion_p = testDispersion(res, plot = FALSE)$p.value,
    outliers_p = testOutliers(res, type = "bootstrap", plot = FALSE)$p.value,
    quantiles_vs_fitted_p = testQuantiles(res, plot = FALSE)$p.value
  )
})
write.csv(residual_tests, file.path(table_dir, "residual_tests.csv"), row.names = F)
residual_tests

# Conventional checks on the conditional residuals
imap(models, \(m, trait) list(normality = check_normality(m$full), heteroscedasticity = check_heteroscedasticity(m$full)))

# Robustness to non-normal residuals: refit Eq. 4 with Student-t errors
t_refit <- imap_dfr(traits, function(data, trait) {
  m_t <- glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                 family = t_family(), data = data)
  map_dfr(list(Gaussian = models[[trait]]$full, `Student t` = m_t), .id = "error_distribution", \(m) {
    s <- summary(m)$coefficients$cond
    tibble(across = s["genus_mean_MAP", 1], across_se = s["genus_mean_MAP", 2], across_p = s["genus_mean_MAP", 4],
           within = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 1], within_se = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 2], within_p = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 4],
           t_df = if (family(m)$family == "t") family_params(m)[[1]] else NA_real_, AIC = AIC(m))
  }) |> mutate(trait = trait, .before = 1)
})
write.csv(t_refit, file.path(table_dir, "t_distribution_refit.csv"), row.names = F)
t_refit
```

## Influence of single genera
```{r}
# Refit Eq. 4 without one genus at a time and record the change in the two fixed slopes
leave_one_genus_out <- imap_dfr(traits, function(data, trait) {
  full <- summary(models[[trait]]$full)$coefficients$cond
  map_dfr(sort(unique(data$genus)), function(g) {
    m <- glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus),
                 data = filter(data, genus != g))
    s <- summary(m)$coefficients$cond
    tibble(trait = trait, genus_removed = g, n_taxa = sum(data$genus == g),
           across = s["genus_mean_MAP", 1], within = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 1],
           across_p = s["genus_mean_MAP", 4], within_p = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 4],
           # Change in units of the full-model SE
           across_change_se = (across - full["genus_mean_MAP", 1]) / full["genus_mean_MAP", 2],
           within_change_se = (within - full["diff_from_genus_MAP", 1]) / full["diff_from_genus_MAP", 2])
  })
})
write.csv(leave_one_genus_out, file.path(table_dir, "leave_one_genus_out.csv"), row.names = F)

leave_one_genus_out |>
  group_by(trait) |>
  summarise(across_min = min(across), across_max = max(across), within_min = min(within), within_max = max(within),
            max_abs_change_se = max(abs(c(across_change_se, within_change_se))),
            refits_with_across_p_over_0.05 = sum(across_p > 0.05), refits_with_within_p_over_0.05 = sum(within_p > 0.05))

# The five most influential genera for each trait
leave_one_genus_out |>
  mutate(max_change_se = pmax(abs(across_change_se), abs(within_change_se))) |>
  group_by(trait) |>
  slice_max(max_change_se, n = 5)
```

## Random effects: likelihood-ratio tests and confidence intervals
```{r}
# Tests on the boundary (variance = 0) are conservative: the reported P values are upper bounds
lrt <- function(reduced, full, label) {
  a <- anova(reduced, full)
  tibble(test = label, chisq = a$Chisq[2], df = a$`Chi Df`[2], p = a$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2])
}
random_effect_tests <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) bind_rows(
  lrt(m$no_genus_slope, m$full, "Genus random slope (variance and correlation)"),
  lrt(m$no_genus, m$no_genus_slope, "Genus random intercept"),
  lrt(m$no_family, m$full, "Family random intercept")
) |> mutate(trait = trait, .before = 1))
write.csv(random_effect_tests, file.path(table_dir, "random_effect_tests.csv"), row.names = F)
random_effect_tests

# Wald 95% CIs, computed on the log-SD scale and back-transformed
random_effect_ci <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) {
  ci <- confint(m$full, parm = "theta_", method = "wald")
  tibble(trait = trait, parameter = rownames(ci), estimate = ci[, "Estimate"], conf.low = ci[, "2.5 %"], conf.high = ci[, "97.5 %"])
})
write.csv(random_effect_ci, file.path(table_dir, "random_effect_ci.csv"), row.names = F)
random_effect_ci

# Range of genus slopes implied by the random-slope SD (fixed slope +/- 1.96 SD)
imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) {
  b <- fixef(m$full)$cond["diff_from_genus_MAP"]
  sd_slope <- attr(VarCorr(m$full)$cond$genus, "stddev")[2]
  tibble(trait = trait, mean_slope = b, sd_slope = sd_slope, lower = b - 1.96 * sd_slope, upper = b + 1.96 * sd_slope)
})
```

## Sensitivity to the two largest genera
```{r}
fixed_summary <- function(m, label, data) {
  s <- summary(m)$coefficients$cond
  r <- r2(m)
  tibble(subset = label, n_taxa = nrow(data), n_genera = n_distinct(data$genus),
         across = s["genus_mean_MAP", 1], across_se = s["genus_mean_MAP", 2], across_p = s["genus_mean_MAP", 4],
         within = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 1], within_se = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 2], within_p = s["diff_from_genus_MAP", 4],
         r2_marginal = r$R2_marginal, r2_conditional = r$R2_conditional)
}
subsets <- list("All taxa" = character(), "Without Eucalyptus" = "Eucalyptus",
                "Without Acacia" = "Acacia", "Without Eucalyptus and Acacia" = c("Eucalyptus", "Acacia"))

sensitivity <- map_dfr(c(Dh = "mean_Dh", VLF = "mean_VLF"), .id = "trait", function(trait_col) {
  imap_dfr(subsets, function(drop, label) {
    data <- center_by_genus(filter(xylem_stats, !genus %in% drop), trait_col, "log_y")
    m <- glmmTMB(log_y ~ genus_mean_MAP + diff_from_genus_MAP + (1 | family) + (diff_from_genus_MAP | genus), data = data)
    fixed_summary(m, label, data)
  })
})
write.csv(sensitivity, file.path(table_dir, "sensitivity_large_genera.csv"), row.names = F)
sensitivity
```

## Complete model tables
```{r}
# Both models of each trait use the same 480 taxa and maximum likelihood, so AIC is comparable
model_comparison <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) {
  map_dfr(c(mixed = "full", pooled = "pooled"), .id = "model", \(name) {
    fit <- m[[name]]
    ll <- logLik(fit)
    r <- r2(fit)
    tibble(n = nobs(fit), parameters = attr(ll, "df"), logLik = as.numeric(ll), AIC = AIC(fit), BIC = BIC(fit),
           r2_marginal = if (name == "full") r$R2_marginal else r$R2,
           r2_conditional = if (name == "full") r$R2_conditional else NA_real_)
  }) |> mutate(trait = trait, .before = 1, delta_AIC = AIC - min(AIC))
})
write.csv(model_comparison, file.path(table_dir, "model_comparison.csv"), row.names = F)
model_comparison

# All fixed and random parameters with 95% CIs
model_parameters <- imap_dfr(models, \(m, trait) {
  map_dfr(c(mixed = "full", pooled = "pooled"), .id = "model", \(name) {
    as_tibble(parameters::model_parameters(m[[name]], effects = "all"))
  }) |> mutate(trait = trait, .before = 1)
})
write.csv(model_parameters, file.path(table_dir, "model_parameters.csv"), row.names = F)
model_parameters
```
